{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_completed = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = real_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
